name: Ward
meaning: raise a guard of light over a body that is yours
why: The paladin's centre: shields and wards. Draws on Light's Glow (a steady light that stays) and Life's Heal (keeping the body whole). Frame, because a guard holds a structure together; it holds inward, EN = 2.5 + 0.4 x 0.4 = 2.66 (as Earth's Harden and Blood's Clot, the other guards). As a means it guards the cast itself: Braced.

name: Humble
meaning: bring a guard down: shields, armour and the boons on a foe
why: Ward's opposite: a guard broken, not raised. Draws on Light's Shine (the gaps shown) taken further. Branch, as Earth's Crumble, the other guard-breaker; outward, EN = 2.5 - 0.6 x 0.7 = 2.08. Uses the existing Exposed status. (Sunder was the first name; Metal already has it.)

name: Bless
meaning: give a boon to a body that is yours
why: Buffs, the support's work. Draws on Life's Strengthen and on the first-pass Light rune Halo ('a radiance that strengthens allies', design/14 section 3). Link: it passes strength on. Giving, EN = 2.0.

name: Condemn
why: Favour's opposite: disfavour. Draws on Light's Shine (a Condemned foe is Lit) and Life's Tithe-like taking (hits on it feed your ward). Cap: a judgement ends a structure; holding inward, EN = 2.5 + 0.8 x 1.5 = 3.7.

name: Absolve
meaning: lift a burden from a body: holds, slows, fear, blindness
why: Cleansing. Draws on Life's Cure (a cleanse) and Light's Clarity (sight and fear lifted), but lifts binds where Cure ends afflictions, so the two never overlap. Cap: it lets everything go and ends; strongly giving, EN = 2.5 - 0.7 x 1.5 = 1.45. As a means, the cast's own burden lifted: cheaper and cooler (the nearest honest ops).

name: Penance
meaning: lay a burden on a foe that it pays for itself
why: Absolve's opposite: a burden laid, not lifted. Draws on Life's Weaken (blows wasted) and Light's judgement (it burns). Link; inward, EN = 3.1.

name: Hallow
meaning: make a place holy, and keep what is yours in it
why: Wards on the ground: the paladin's stand. Draws on Light's Glow and Still Lamp (a light given a place). Frame: it holds a place together; EN = 2.5 + 0.3 x 0.4 = 2.62. As a means: it lasts.

name: Exile
meaning: drive a foe out and keep it out
why: Hallow's opposite in space: a place kept for yours, a foe cast out of it. Draws on Light's Radiate (light poured outward). Branch; strongly outward, EN = 2.5 - 0.8 x 0.7 = 1.94. Distinct from Death's Exorcise (which banishes the unliving) and the universal Repel (base beats universal: Exile also keeps them out).

name: Mercy
meaning: soften harm and give it back as healing
why: Holy's one true heal, made of harm softened. Draws on Life's Heal. Link: it takes harm in and passes it on as health; holding back, EN = 2.9. As a means: gentler and cooler.

name: Wrath
why: Mercy's opposite. The paladin needs a hit, and this is it. Draws on Light's Radiate (light outward, EN 1.87); same role and draw, EN = 2.5 - 0.9 x 0.7 = 1.87.

name: Zeal
why: Movement for a paladin: the charge. Draws on Light's straight instant line. Link; outward, EN = 2.0. Distinct from Lightning's Quicken (nerves) and Wind's speed: it is the will to close.

name: Patience
meaning: wait for the blow, and answer it
why: Zeal's opposite: holding ground until the moment. Draws on Light's Reflect (turning back what comes). Cap: it ends a structure with its answer; holding, EN = 2.5 + 0.6 x 1.5 = 3.4. As a means: a slower, heavier cast, as Sow.
